name: Eyes on Earth — Sun-Sync Reach Failure
description: Failing test fixture: orbit and launcher incompatibility. The spacecraft design pairs a Sun-Synchronous Orbit (sso-600) with Launcher Alpha (launch-a), which only supports low-inclination low Earth orbit (leo-500). All internal spacecraft subsystem constraints pass, isolating the trajectory delivery failure.

expectedScore.note: Feasibility fails at FC-6 (Orbit and launcher compatibility). The launch vehicle does not possess the upper-stage performance or guidance capabilities to inject the satellite into a retrograde sun-synchronous inclination.

failureExplanation: The player selected Sun-Synchronous Orbit (sso-600), but chose Launcher Alpha (launch-a). According to the launcher specification, Launcher Alpha only supports Low Earth Orbit (leo-500) due to thrust and delta-V limitations. To fix this mission, the player must either change the orbit to Low Earth Orbit (leo-500) or upgrade to Launcher Beta (launch-b), which is certified for both LEO and SSO trajectories.
